newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta stocks end slightly up as Maharani soars.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta stocks end slightly up as Maharani soars.

text.p: Jakarta stocks ended slightly up on Wednesday on the back of active buying in secondaries and a sharp rise in price of newly-listed finance firm Maharani, brokers said.
The Jakarta Composite Index closed 1.29 points, or 0.18 percent higher, at 723.50 points after moving to a high of 725.23 points and a low of 721.20 points during the day.
Losers led gainers by 65 to 59, with 64 counters unchanged. Total volume was about 571.9 billion rupiah.
Brokers said overall market sentiment was mixed as some investors took profits after recent sharp gains.
But the encouraging debut of finance firm Maharani coupled with sustained buying in cement maker Indocement in early trade had helped index to inch up.
"The closing price of Maharani today is amazing. It soared 50 percent," a broker with local firm said, adding that the debut of Maharani had boosted sentiment particularly in secondaries.

Maharani, controlled by President Suharto's daughter -- Siti Hediati Prabowo -- was last traded at 900 rupiah, against it offer price of 600 rupiah. It was the most active stock with 58.8 million shares changing hands.
Brokers expect the market to be slow on Friday ahead of weekend after it is closed on Thursday for a public holiday.
